title: Attention Sinks as Spectral Spikes: A Mechanism Analysis of Gated Attention
abstract: arXiv:2611.20403v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Transformer attention exhibits attention sinks, where a small subset of source tokens absorbs disproportionate attention mass across layers. Recent work shows that post-SDPA output gating strongly reduces attention-sink behavior, while separate studies link attention sinks to gradient sinks and massive activations through backward training dynamics. Yet how the same gate affects forward sink structure, backward gradient concentration, and training-time representation signatures remains unclear. We address this gap by formulating attention sinks as sink-induced low-rank modes in token-space covariance, with directions aligned to high-mass attention columns. Under this view, post-SDPA gating acts as a mode-dependent contraction: it attenuates sink-induced spectral energy in the forward pass and locally reduces value-path gradients routed through sink columns in the backward pass. translated_title: 注意力汇聚作为谱尖峰：门控注意力的机制分析
translated_abstract: Transformer注意力表现出“注意力汇聚”现象，即一小部分源token在各层中吸收了不成比例的注意力质量。近期研究表明，SDPA之后的输出门控能显著减少注意力汇聚行为；另有研究通过反向传播训练动态将注意力汇聚与梯度汇聚和大规模激活联系起来。然而，同一门控机制如何影响前向汇聚结构、反向梯度集中以及训练时的表示特征，仍不清楚。我们通过将注意力汇聚形式化为token空间协方差中由汇聚诱导的低秩模态来填补这一空白，其方向与高质量注意力列对齐。在这一视角下，SDPA后门控表现为一种模态依赖的收缩：它在前向传播中衰减汇聚诱导的谱能量，并在反向传播中局部减少经由汇聚列传递的值路径梯度。经验上，随机矩阵诊断表明门控……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文将注意力汇聚理论化为token空间协方差中的低秩谱模态，并证明SDPA后门控通过模态依赖的收缩在前向传播中抑制汇聚谱能量、在反向传播中削减汇聚梯度，从而从机制上统一解释了门控为何能缓解注意力汇聚。
en_tdlr: This paper formulates attention sinks as low-rank spectral modes in token-space covariance and shows that post-SDPA gating acts as a mode-dependent contraction, attenuating sink-induced spectral energy in the forward pass and sink-routed value-path gradients in the backward pass, thereby providing a unified mechanistic account of why gating reduces attention sinks.
